skill.summary: 抖音内容爬虫，支持自然语言搜索视频内容，基于浏览器自动化实现

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of douyin-scraper skill.
- Enables natural language video search on Douyin using browser automation.
- Supports extracting video title, author, and engagement metrics from search results.
- No-code, fully natural language driven interaction.
- Session persistence and authentication state saving supported.
- Handles common edge cases like missing search box, login popups, or slow pages.
